378YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: In Sermersuaq, four Imperial armies faced roughly equal Thule numbers, but Thule sorcery let them seize the Stonefields; they are expected to take the Silver Peaks by Spring. In Karsk, Varushkan armies allied with the Charnel Lord of the Broken Barrow, yet the Thule pushed toward the Frozen Citadel, and Nitrost is expected to fall by midwinter without help. Elsewhere Segura fell quiet pending diplomacy, Reikos went silent, and ettercap overran Brocéliande. At Holberg, more than thirty-five thousand defenders withstood siege engines, ogres and Druj-bound marshwalkers. The Druj, undone partly by their own Spring curse, retreated, while the Empire lost around three thousand troops.

n.Dawn: Dawnish forces at Drycastle helped resupply hidden outposts in the Barrens, and the Golden Sun sallied from Holberg to strike down marshwalkers and battering rams.
n.Druj: The Druj assault on Holfried under the scorpion banner failed, costing them perhaps ten thousand casualties, partly because their own Spring curse festered their wounds. They still hold Reikos and outer Holberg.
n.Grendel: The Grendel port of Apulus was devastated by the tempest, damaging their ability to supply their forces in Spiral. Their army avoided direct confrontation with the Highborn there.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Fist of the Mountain fought the Thule in the Silver Peaks, and the Summer Storm's discipline steadied Holberg's defenders and opened the path for the sally against the marshwalkers.
n.Jotun: The Jotun still held northern Liathaven and remained cautious in the Mournwold, where stories spread of lost Marcher folk returning home from their territory.
n.Navarr: The Navarr forests were largely quiet: Hercynia's last Thule were driven off from Treji and Therunin was safe again. Liathaven remained divided and Brocéliande was overrun by monstrous insects.
n.The Brass Coast: The Fire of the South fought the Thule in the Silver Peaks, while in Segura the Freeborn and Lasambrian orcs stopped fighting to await diplomacy.
n.The League: League forces including the Towerjacks and Wolves of War held the walls of Holfried. The Wolves of War's engines countered the Druj war machines and saved hundreds of lives.
n.The Marches: The Bounders sallied from Holberg against the marshwalkers. In the Mournwold the scarecrow ring was weakening, work began on an armoured garrison, and Marcher folk thought lost were reportedly returning home.
n.Thule: The Thule seized the Stonefields in Sermersuaq and pushed the Varushkans back toward the Frozen Citadel in Karsk, but their last forces in Hercynia were routed.
n.Urizen: The Citadel's sentinels and mages bore the brunt of Druj poison at Holberg, healing defenders and hurling orcs from the ramparts. Visten in Redoubt was also struck by the storms.
n.Varushka: Three Varushkan armies, aided by the Charnel Lord's banner of bone and raven feathers, were slowly forced back in Karsk. Nitrost is expected to fall to the Thule by midwinter unless reinforcements arrive.
n.Wintermark: The Green Shield and the Winter Sun, with a thousand husks from Holberg, fought the Thule in Sermersuaq but could only slow their advance as the Stonefields were lost.

t.Bay of Catazar: A supernatural tempest made the western Bay treacherous all Summer, tearing sails and dragging ships near the Spiral coast into maelstroms.
t.Brocéliande: The orcs left Elerael, but monstrous insects and wicked ettercap swarmed into the empty glades.
t.Hercynia: The last Thule failed to break the thorns defending rebuilt Treji and retreated, badly outclassed, into the deep woods.
t.Holberg: The Druj siege of the upper city was repelled with immense orc losses, though around three thousand Imperial troops fell and the city remains overcrowded, diseased and close to riot.
t.Karsk: Magical citadels rose on both sides as the Thule tested Varushkan defences and then drove them back in Nitrost, threatening to retake the territory.
t.Liathaven: The Jotun still held the north and the vallorn its heart, while the southern Imperial settlements remained isolated by distance and bandits.
t.Mournwold: The scarecrow ring at Overton was weakening, so work began on an armoured garrison, and returning Marcher folk were reported.
t.Redoubt: Visten was battered by the storms, and the Ribbon of Salt regio briefly became a churning fountain raining debris on the docks.
t.Reikos: The territory fell ominously silent: resistance groups had not been heard from and scouts found camps emptied or did not return.
t.Segura: After nine months of war the fighting stopped, with Lasambrian orcs holding their positions while both sides waited on diplomacy.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: fleeing citizens and refugees from Holberg headed west to Semmerholm and beyond.
t.Sermersuaq: The Thule took the Stonefields and raided deep into the territory, while Spring magic saved lives and promised healthy herds come Spring.
t.Spiral: The tempest reshaped the coastline and wrecked Apulus. The Valiant Pegasus sheltered in the Fist, and neither side sought battle.
t.The Barrens: With Dawnish help, Imperial scouts resupplied hidden outposts and began reporting orc fighting orc and the Spires of Dusk under siege.
t.Therunin: The forest was safe again with no Druj from Reikos, and the Feverwater dredgers recovered occasional treasures.
t.Upwold: Mentioned in passing: there were no large-scale engagements along the western front from Segura to Upwold, only skirmishes.

r.Brocéliande/Dark Ranging: Monstrous insects swarmed out of Dark Ranging into the glades left empty by the orcs.
r.Brocéliande/Elerael: The orcs abandoned Elerael, and ettercap and giant insects quickly moved in to hunt there.
r.Brocéliande/Vale's Lament: Monstrous insects spread from Vale's Lament into neighbouring Elerael.
r.Holberg/Holfried: The unbreached walls of the upper city withstood the full Druj assault, including marshwalkers and ogre-drawn rams, until the orcs retreated.
r.Holberg/Holmauer: The ruined outer city remained in Druj hands, and stone from it was hurled at Holfried. The defeated orcs withdrew back beyond it.
r.Holberg/Rebeshof: The Druj built their great siege engines on the plains of Rebeshof and fell back there after their defeat.
r.Holberg/Utterlund: Retreating Druj withdrew into the forests and marshes of Utterlund.
r.Karsk/Branoc: The dark sovereign of the Broken Barrow allied with the Empire and sent its fog-shrouded Charnel Banner against the Thule.
r.Karsk/Krevsaty: Thule sorcery raised a citadel of orichalcum and bronze around the ruins of Oloy.
r.Karsk/Moresvah: Thule strikes hit Moresvah and targeted the supply train bound for Nitrost.
r.Karsk/Nitrost: The Thule attacked the Frozen Citadel and rebuilt vales, pushing the Varushkans back. Nitrost is expected to fall by midwinter without reinforcements.
r.Segura/Burnish: Lasambrian orcs held their positions in Burnish as the fighting paused for diplomacy.
r.Segura/Yellow Chase: Lasambrian orcs held Yellow Chase while warily watching the Freeborn without engaging.
r.Sermersuaq/East Floes: Hunters of the Thule Ice Shard Banner struck deep into East Floes.
r.Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks: The Thule claimed the Stonefields, and unless something changes they are expected to take the whole Silver Peaks by Spring.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount: Ice Shard Banner raiders struck deep into Suaq Fount.
r.Spiral/Apulus: Seven waterspouts reportedly shattered the Grendel docks and buildings, leaving the port even more ruined and hampering Grendel supply.

Archive:378YE Autumn Equinox Imperial ti.d: The record listed senators for each Imperial territory, the generals of every Imperial army, the cardinals and gatekeepers of the virtue assemblies, the six archmagi and the grandmasters of the Conclave's orders, and the holders of Imperial and national Bourse seats with their winning bids. Other offices included Gideon of the Suns of Couros as Conscience of the Senate, Sendero i Hazana i Guerra as Admiral and Vaan of Auric Horizon as Warmage. The Senate selected Syn Nighthaven as Wisest Senator. The Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by the Druj and would not be auctioned until those territories were Imperial again.

n.Dawn: Dawn's senators were Bohemond De Rondell, Escalados deCarsenere and Valentin Ivarovich Orzel. Its generals led the Hounds of Glory, Golden Sun and Eastern Sky, and Agnetha and Tancred De Rondell held Synod seats in Wisdom and Loyalty.
n.Druj: The Druj held the Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund, so neither Bourse seat would be auctioned until Reikos and Holberg were Imperial territories again.
n.Highguard: Highguard had three senators and three generals, including those of the Seventh Wave, Granite Pillar and Valiant Pegasus. Its citizens held the Courage, Loyalty and Pride cardinalships, two gatekeeper roles and the grandmastership of the Order of the Sevenfold Path.
n.Imperial Orcs: Generals Bloodcrow Martok and Braka led the Winter Sun and Summer Storm. Irontide Bruc was Advisor on Orc Affairs, Irontide Rad was Quartermaster General and Irontide Vio held the Steel Fist.
n.Navarr: Navarr's senators were Rhain, Syn Nighthaven, who was also chosen as Wisest Senator, and Caerwyn Summer Crow. Its generals led the Black Thorns and Quiet Step, Meir Pathfinder led the Order of the Rod and Shield, and Idris Eternal held the Thimble.
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast had four senators and two generals, of the Red Wind Corsairs and the Fire of the South. Sendero i Hazana i Guerra was Admiral and Edmundo I Jannat I Riqueza led the Order of the Golden Pyramid, and several Freeborn held mercantile posts and sinecures.
n.The League: The League's senators were Mirislav, Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato and Drogon Morosini, and Gabriel Barossa commanded the Wolves of War. Leaguers held the Ambition and Prosperity cardinalships, the Conclave bursar and Senate liaison roles, and many Bourse seats.
n.The Marches: The Marches had senators Orrick, Bridget Eastville and Henry Ward. Its generals Furious Fin, Jack Flint and Brianna of King's Stoke led the Drakes, Strong Reeds and Bounders.
n.Urizen: Urizen's senators were Ariadne, Marissa Shatterspire and Cato, and Tanwyn Ankarien led the Citadel Guard. Livia Cascade was Gatekeeper of Wisdom, Solas was High Exorcist and Sibella held the Legacy.
n.Varushka: Varushka had senators Constantin, Radomir and Irina Kardaova Arkady, and generals of the Northern Eagle and Golden Axe. Varushkans also held the Auditor of Senatorial Accountability, the Imperial Inquisitor, the Dean of the Lyceum, the grandmastership of the Shuttered Lantern and two national Bourse seats.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark's four senators were Hengest Dun, Uskolli, Atte and Jorma Steelhail. Its generals Vahne and Erkenbrand of Tyrsholm led the Green Shield and Fist of the Mountain, and Wintermarkers held the Stonefield Ice Caves, the Brilliant Shore and the trade envoy post to the Sumaah Republic.

t.Kahraman: Mentioned in passing: Zamira i Covas i Erigo was listed as its senator.
t.Kallavesa: Mentioned in passing: Uskolli was listed as its senator.

t.Weirwater: Mentioned in passing: Valentin Ivarovich Orzel was listed as its senator, and Niccolo dos Tassatos held the Weirwater Vales for 98 Thrones.
t.Zenith: Mentioned in passing: Cato was listed as its senator.

r.Holberg/Ennerlund: The Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by the Druj and would not be auctioned until Holberg was once again an Imperial territory.

As above, so below.d: The Door, the Stork, the Web and the Great Wyrm aligned around the Wanderer, the eye of change, which burned crimson in the sky. Out of season, the winter lights shone brighter than any mystic or volhov could remember. Magicians and others reported a distant chord, vertigo, dreams of history branching and merging, an overwhelming sense of interconnection, and ideas that challenged their deepest beliefs. During the equinox no new ritual effect could be improvised. Mastered rituals, Imperial lore, non-Imperial texts, messages to eternals and gifts to their realms still worked. Covens could draw on their bond for three rituals a day, and making enchantments or curses permanent needed less ilium.

n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: Thule is not named, but the lights stretched across Karsk, part of which Thule held, as far as Crowslook.
n.Varushka: Varushkan volhov were among those astonished by lights brighter than any of them remembered, and Varushkan ritualists shared in the conjunction's limits on improvised magic and its strengthened coven bonds.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark's mystics saw the winter lights blaze in autumn over Sermersuaq, brighter than they had ever known, and its ritualists felt the conjunction's effects on their magic.

t.Karsk: Karsk marked the eastern edge of the spectacle, where the out-of-season winter lights coiled across the night sky as far as Crowslook.
t.Sermersuaq: Sermersuaq marked the western edge of the display, where the great winter lights shone over Tanikipari in autumn.

r.Karsk/Crowslook: Crowslook was named as the eastern limit of the region where the brilliant winter lights could be seen.
r.Sermersuaq/Tanikipari: Tanikipari was named as the western limit of the region where the winter lights blazed during the conjunction.

Construct Academy Religious Studies sine.d: Proposed by Casinea and seconded by the Conscience of the Senate, the motion created a sinecure, described as the "Custodian of the Academy Religious Studies", producing 18 liao each season for the Academy's use. It passed at a cost of 30 thrones. Construction required 10 wains of white granite, 2 thrones 4 crowns and three months; Zephram of Cantiarch's Hold supplied the materials and money after the Winter Solstice 378YE. On completion it creates the Imperial title of Dean of Pilgrims, a lifetime appointment open to any Imperial citizen and appointed by the Senate. It can be revoked by the General Assembly or the Assembly of the Nine.

n.Urizen: A Urizen territory hosts the new Academy sinecure, and the granite and coin to build it came from Zephram of Cantiarch's Hold.

t.Morrow: The sinecure is built at Canterspire in Morrow and will produce 18 liao each season for the Academy.

Construct Mercantile Exchange in Temesch.d: Proposed by the senator for Temeschwar and seconded by the senator for Necropolis, the motion sought to commission a Great Work, the Lukash Biessek von Temeschwar Mercantile Exchange. It would have cost 40 wains of white granite and 10 thrones, taken three months to construct and carried no upkeep. Once complete it would have produced 900 rings, divided between the businesses owned by League citizens in Temeschwar. The motion was defeated, so the exchange was not built and no progress was made.

n.The League: League merchants and business owners in Temeschwar missed out on a share of 900 rings that the proposed exchange would have provided, after the motion put forward by their own senator failed.

t.Temeschwar: The planned mercantile exchange in Temeschwar was never built after the motion was defeated, leaving the territory's businesses without the extra income it would have generated.

Construct Starlight Drift of Shimmering.d: The motion was proposed by Zenith and seconded by Redoubt. It created the sinecure "Starlight Drift of Shimmering Snow" in Zenith, to produce 9 crystal mana each season. The senator said the motion would be self-funded, and after the Autumn Equinox 378YE Cato, senator for Zenith, supplied the full cost of 10 wains of mithril and 2 thrones. Construction takes three months. When it is complete, the sinecure will automatically create the title of Custodian of the Starlight Drift. This is a lifetime national position, appointed by unanimous decision of Urizen's senators. The Urizen assembly, the General Assembly or the Assembly of Nine can revoke it.

n.Urizen: Urizen gains a new national title, Custodian of the Starlight Drift, which Urizen's senators will fill unanimously and which the Urizen assembly can revoke, along with a steady source of crystal mana.

t.Zenith: The Starlight Drift of Shimmering Snow is to be built in Zenith at its own senator's expense, and once complete it will produce 9 crystal mana each season there.

Construct Sylvihrafn Crystal Henge.d: Proposed by the senator for Skarsind and seconded by Kallavesa, the motion created a mana-producing sinecure costing 10 wains of mithril and 2 thrones, with three months of construction. Jorma Steelhail, senator for Skarsind, supplied the full cost after the Autumn Equinox 378YE. On completion the henge creates the title of Guardian of the Cairn, which yields 9 crystal mana each season. The title is a national position, usually held for life, appointed by unanimous decision of Wintermark's senators. It can be revoked by the Wintermark Assembly, the General Assembly or the Assembly of Nine.

n.Wintermark: Wintermark gains a new national title, the Guardian of the Cairn, appointed unanimously by its senators and drawing nine crystal mana a season from the henge, with funding supplied by its own senator Jorma Steelhail.

t.Skarsind: The Sylvi Hrafn Crystal Henge is to be built in Skarsind, proposed and paid for by the territory's senator, Jorma Steelhail.

Construct fortified manor in Liathaven.d: Proposed by Therunin and seconded by Miekarova, the motion passed in principle in Autumn 378YE. It called for a fortified garrison at Beacon Point, with a view to future upgrades. The work cost 8 wains of white granite and 2 Thrones and took three months. The materials were supplied by Caerwyn after the Summer Solstice 379YE. Once complete, the manor was meant to protect the people of Beacon Point from the worst of Jotun raiding and from bandit attacks in the southern mountains. The fortified steading was lost when the Jotun invaded Liathaven in late 379YE.

n.Jotun: Jotun raiding was one of the threats the manor was built to guard against, and the fortified steading was destroyed during the Jotun invasion of Liathaven in late 379YE.
n.Navarr: The motion sought to protect the Navarr people of Beacon Point with a fortified refuge, but the defence was lost when the Jotun invaded Liathaven in late 379YE.

t.Liathaven: Liathaven was to gain a fortified manor as a refuge against Jotun raids and mountain bandits, but it was destroyed in the Jotun invasion of the territory in late 379YE.

r.Liathaven/Beacon Point: Beacon Point was the chosen site for the fortified manor, which was funded with Caerwyn's granite and Thrones in 379YE and later lost to the Jotun invasion.

Create law of delegation protection.d: Proposed by Miaren and seconded by Segura, the motion created a law stating that any delegation from a barbarian nation arriving on the field at Anvil under a flag of peace should be protected under the law as citizens while visiting the Empire. It carried no cost. In practice the law appears to have extended the status of foreigner to any barbarian delegation that reached Anvil, rather than full citizenship. The law was later amended during the Winter Solstice 378YE.

n.Highguard: Mentioned in passing: Highguard is not named in the motion; its connection appears to be through the proposer or seconder, Miaren and Segura.

t.Casinea: Mentioned in passing: Casinea is not named in the motion; its link appears to be through the senator who proposed or seconded it.

Declare peace with Lasambrian orcs.d: Proposed by Segura's senator and seconded by Astolat, the motion passed at 110 Thrones, with the funds disbursed to Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra, Senator for Segura. The magistrate ruled that a declaration of peace is absolute because a Senate motion cannot bind a future Senate, so the conditions were for information only; a future Senate could declare war if they went unmet. After the Autumn Equinox the Lasambrian orcs ceded their Seguran regions to the Empire and withdrew into the Lasambrian hills. Dawn's Eastern Sky army then claimed the vacated regions, facing only token resistance from a few orcs who refused to leave and from bandits who had prospered without Imperial law.

n.Dawn: Dawn's Eastern Sky army claimed the regions the Lasambrian orcs vacated for the Empire, overcoming token resistance from holdout orcs and bandits. Astolat, a Dawnish territory, seconded the motion.
n.The Brass Coast: Segura's senator, Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra, proposed the peace and received the funds, and the Brass Coast recovered the Seguran regions the Lasambrian orcs had occupied.

t.Segura: The Lasambrian orcs handed back the regions of Segura they still held and withdrew into the Lasambrian hills, after which the Eastern Sky reclaimed them for the Empire against scattered orc and bandit resistance.

Disburse funds to aid Liathaven citizens.d: The motion, proposed by the senator for Kallavesa and seconded by the senator for Therunin, asked the Senate to send an aid package to Liathaven. It passed at 10 thrones in Autumn 378YE, and the funds were disbursed to Uskolli, Senator for Kallavesa. Geraint Broad-Backed made a further contribution to the project through the civil service: 4 thrones, 7 crowns, 16 rings and 5 measures of ambergelt. The page does not record how the aid was used or what came of it.

n.Navarr: Senators from two Navarr territories, Kallavesa and Therunin, led the effort, and the Kallavesa senator Uskolli received the money to aid the people of Liathaven.

t.Liathaven: Liathaven was the intended recipient of the aid package, meant to help its citizens, with 10 thrones of Senate money plus Geraint Broad-Backed's private donation behind it.

Drain the flooded streets of Caricomare.d: Proposed by Sarvos and seconded by Zenith, the motion sought no Senate funding. The cost of 50 wains of white granite and 50 Thrones was presented by Mirislav, Senator for Sarvos, after the Autumn Equinox, and construction took six months with no upkeep. Completion created the Mayor of Caricomare, appointed by the sitting senator for Sarvos, paid 15 Crowns a season and holding 25 votes in territorial elections. The Constitutional Court let the unusual appointment method pass scrutiny. It later judged the sinecure unconstitutional because it gives senatorial votes to people not present at Anvil. The motion was not struck down, but no future sinecure of this kind will be approved.

n.The League: A League senator restored a historic flooded district of Sarvos and gained a new League title, the Mayor of Caricomare. The precedent of appointing a voter in a senatorial election will not be repeated for future League sinecures.

t.Sarvos: The sunken docks and flooded streets of Caricomare in Sarvos were rebuilt, making the district habitable again. Sarvos gained a Mayor of Caricomare, appointed by its senator and holding 25 votes in its territorial elections.

Fortify Overton.d: Proposed by the senator for Mitwold and seconded by Bregasland, the commission called for 100 wains of white granite, a year's construction time and upkeep of 10 Thrones. Bridget Eastville of the Marches provided 25 wains after each of the Winter Solstice 378YE, Spring Equinox, Summer Solstice and Autumn Equinox 379YE, and Orchard's Watch was completed. The Civil Service made accounting and processing errors, delaying the recording of the Summer shipment and wrongly claiming that construction could not finish in time. A Senate commission in fact has a year to begin construction, not to complete it. The page's overview places Overton in the Mournwold, but the motion itself names Mitwold.

n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun are not named, and the page refers only to the Mournwold, which they held at the time, in its summary of where Overton lies.
n.The Marches: Marcher senators for Mitwold and Bregasland proposed and seconded the fortification. The Marcher Bridget Eastville single-handedly supplied all 100 wains of white granite to complete Orchard's Watch.

t.Mitwold: Mitwold gained a new fortification, Orchard's Watch, at Overton, built on the motion of its own senator.
t.Mournwold: Mentioned in passing: the page's overview describes Overton as being in the Mournwold, though the motion itself places it in Mitwold.

Fortify Tassato.d: The fortification's standard cost was 80 wains of white granite and 20 Thrones, or 100 wains of white granite. It would take a year to build and need 10 Thrones of upkeep. Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato paid for all of it in instalments across four seasons. He gave 20 wains after the Autumn Equinox 378YE, 20 wains and 10 Thrones after the Winter Solstice, 20 wains and 10 Thrones after the Spring Equinox 379YE, and a final 20 wains after the Summer Solstice 379YE. The Rezia Redoubt was then reported complete.

n.The League: The League gained a new fortification in its city-territory of Tassato, paid for entirely by the League citizen Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: the page describes no Urizen involvement in the fortification's commission or construction.

t.Redoubt: Mentioned in passing: the territory plays no part in the motion, and the shared name comes only from the new fortification's title, the Rezia Redoubt.
t.Tassato: Tassato's senator proposed the motion, and the territory gained the completed Rezia Redoubt fortification, which carries an upkeep of 10 Thrones.

r.Tassato/Tassato Mestra: Tassato Mestra is the site of the Rezia Redoubt, built from white granite over the year after Autumn 378YE and reported complete.

Research the vallorn for the Academy.d: Proposed by the senator for Astolat and seconded by the senator for Miaren, the motion authorised a research project into the origins of the vallorn, with the Civil Service compiling the findings for the Academy. The senator for Astolat indicated the motion would be self-funded, and the 5 Thrones required have been provided. Information about the vallorn is being compiled, and the resulting report is to be delivered to Bohemond De Rondell, Senator for Astolat.

n.Dawn: A Dawnish senator, Bohemond De Rondell of Astolat, proposed and personally funded the research and is to receive the finished report on the vallorn.

t.Astolat: Astolat's senator proposed the motion, met its 5 Throne cost, and will be the recipient of the Civil Service's report on the origin of the vallorn.
